links.outcome: Ambient scribe effects on well-being, note time, documentation quality, and billing codes in local randomized trial
links.effect: Work exhaustion/interpersonal disengagement -0.44 points (95% CI -0.62 to -0.25); time on notes -0.36 hours/day; PDSQI-9 mean scores 3.97 to 4.99 of 5; diagnostic billing codes improved (P<0.001).
links.quote: Documentation time decreased without compromising diagnosis, billing compliance, or note quality.

links.outcome: Coding accuracy/intensity, documentation time, and burnout measured after AI scribe deployment
links.effect: Burnout measure (Stanford PFI) work exhaustion fell 0.44 points; note time fell 0.36 h/day; diagnostic billing codes improved (P<0.001); professional fulfillment +0.14 (P=0.04) nonsignificant.
links.quote: Diagnostic billing codes improved with ambient AI use (P<0.001).

links.outcome: Detection of drift in ambient AI software performance during deployment
links.effect: No drift in software performance was detected during the 24-week trial.
links.quote: No drift in software performance was detected.

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized controlled trial assessing the clinical deployment of an ambient generative AI scribe on clinician well-being, documentation time, and note quality.
